process.title: Describe the fault
process.text: Call or send the form with what is happening and where. If anything is smoking, sparking or hot to the touch, cut the power at the breaker and call rather than message.

faqs.q: Why does my breaker keep tripping?
faqs.a: A breaker that trips repeatedly is doing its job — it is reporting a real fault, usually an overloaded circuit, a short, or a failing appliance. Resetting it over and over is the one response that is genuinely unsafe.

faqs.q: Do I need a permit for electrical work?
faqs.a: PLACEHOLDER — confirm the local permitting position per client and jurisdiction before publishing.

It is not automatically unsafe, but the terminations are where it fails. Homes wired with aluminium branch circuits in the 1960s and 70s usually need the connections remediated rather than the whole house rewired.

faqs.q: Can you install an EV charger in my garage?
faqs.a: Usually. It depends on the spare capacity in your panel and the run to the parking spot. We do a load calculation first rather than assuming the panel can take it.
